thread.title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Securian Asset Management Inc’s 2nd Largest Position

author: ABMN Staff
title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) is Securian Asset Management Inc’s 2nd Largest Position
text:
Securian Asset Management Inc decreased its position in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.8% during the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The fund owned 506,131 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 14,508 shares during the period. Apple comprises approximately 2.3% of Securian Asset Management Inc’s portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest holding. Securian Asset Management Inc’s holdings in Apple were worth $93,690,000 at the end of the most recent reporting period.
Other institutional investors have also recently modified their holdings of the company. Delphi Private Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the second quarter valued at $120,000. Quattro Financial Advisors LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the first quarter valued at $133,000. CX Institutional bought a new stake in Apple in the second quarter valued at $135,000. Gainplan LLC bought a new stake in Apple in the first quarter valued at $200,000. Finally, Chessman Wealth Strategies RIA bought a new stake in Apple in the first quarter valued at $205,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 57.14% of the company’s stock.
